reference:
Roy Clark hosted "Hee Haw", a nationally televised country variety show, from 1969 to 1992.
FINDING: Roy Clark hosted Hee Haw.

descendants_plus.verifier:
CHANGE
"It is broadcast from Monday to Sunday from 18:00 to 19:00 and repeats at 01:00, 06:00 and 10:00. It is currently hosted by Show Luo, William Liao, and Butterfly Chien. There is usually one or two days in a week (Tuesdays and/or Wednesdays, the days when recordings for other pre-recorded episodes actually takes place) that it is broadcast live from the recording studio, on entertainment news, sometimes with guests in attendance; the other days are pre-recorded variety specials and Sundays are repeats or other shows. There are no airings of the show on January 1."

Roy Clark

Final answer: Hee Haw
